messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a side-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a side-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then raises both hands to his head to adjust his hair, and finally lowers his arms to stand still again.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from a low angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white long-sleeved shirt, a black vest, red trousers, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small top-knot or bun on the crown of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, dark skin, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or boardwalk area at dusk, featuring a large pavilion with a string of lights, a red and blue striped barrier, and a small red food cart in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins from a side profile full-body view matching the reference, with the character centered and the pavilion behind. The camera then moves closer, ending in a tighter upper-body framing while the character performs the same head/hair-adjusting action. The person, outfit, hairstyle, environment, and action progression remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a side-view dolly-in shot moving from full-body to upper-body framing, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, appearance, action, timing, and environment.
unexpected_changes: The amusement ride visible on the left in the source is no longer visible in the new side-view framing.
